originalTitle: Tell HN: Gemini trains on chat history, even for subscribers (personal accounts)
content: If you have a personal Google AI subscription, all your saved chat history in Gemini can be used for training and there is no way to opt out unless you turn off chat history or use temporary chat sessions. These chat transcripts may even be read by human reviewers. Although Google claims to disconnect them from your account when human-reviewed, they explicitly warn not to enter confidential information . https://support.google.com/gemini/answer/16836988 “[Gemini app activity] is used to improve Google services for everyone, including by training generative AI models, if your Keep Activity setting is on.“ https://support.google.com/gemini/answer/13594961?hl=en#human_review “A subset of chats are reviewed by human reviewers” https://support.google.com/gemini/answer/13594961?hl=en#pn_retain_data “Chats reviewed by human reviewers [...] are not deleted when you delete your activity. Instead, they are retained for up to three years.” https://support.google.com/gemini/answer/13594961?hl=en#pn_data_usage “Please don’t enter confidential information that you wouldn’t want a reviewer to see or Google to use to improve our services, including machine-learning technologies.” To disable their training on your chat sessions, you need to turn off “Keep Activity” in Gemini’s settings. Turning that off means you’ll lose any chat sessions after 72 hours. I learned this too late, thinking that having a paid subscription = not being turned into the product. Apparently paying is not enough. Thank you to this user on HN for mentioning in another thread: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50355424
chineseTitle: 告诉 HN：Gemini 会根据聊天记录进行训练，甚至针对订阅者（个人帐户）
chineseContent: 如果您有个人 Google AI 订阅，则您在 Gemini 中保存的所有聊天记录都可以用于训练，并且无法选择退出，除非您关闭聊天记录或使用临时聊天会话。这些聊天记录甚至可以被人类审阅者阅读。尽管谷歌声称在人工审核时会断开它们与您帐户的连接，但他们明确警告不要输入机密信息。 https://support.google.com/gemini/answer/16836988 “[Gemini 应用程序活动] 用于改善每个人的 Google 服务，包括在您的“保持活动”设置开启的情况下训练生成式 AI 模型。“ https://support.google.com/gemini/answer/13594961?hl=en# human_review “一部分聊天由人工审核者审核” https://support.google.com/gemini/answer/13594961?hl=en#pn_retain_data “当您删除活动时，人工审核者审核的聊天 [...] 不会被删除。相反，它们最多会保留三年。” https://support.google.com/gemini/answer/13594961?hl=en#pn_data_usage “请不要输入您不希望审阅者看到或 Google 用于改进我们的服务（包括机器学习技术）的机密信息。”要在您的聊天会话中禁用他们的训练，您需要在 Gemini 的设置中关闭“保持活动”。关闭该功能意味着您将在 72 小时后丢失所有聊天会话。我知道这一点太晚了，认为付费订阅=没有转化为产品。显然付费是不够的。感谢 HN 上的这位用户在另一个线程中提到：https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50355424
whyItMatters: 这条信息属于 AI 与科技趋势信号，适合用于观察工具选型、产品机会、开发者关注点和技术路线变化。
